# FortniteEmotesNDances API (reference only)

`IFortniteEmotesAPI.cs` is copied unchanged from https://github.com/Cruze03/FortniteEmotesNDances (`API/`), the small public interface that plugin
publishes so other plugins can talk to it. It is here only so `LegacyX-Emotes` can compile against it. The project is never packaged or deployed:
at runtime the real `FortniteEmotesNDancesAPI.dll` comes from the emotes plugin's own release (`shared/FortniteEmotesNDancesAPI/`).

The upstream repository states no license. Keep this folder to that one interface, and do not copy anything else from it into this repository.
